portalSettingsDescription: Manage employees, organization settings, portal email and audit history.
financeManagementDescription: Manage invoices, income, expenses, consultant balances and company results.
consultantFinanceDescription: Review your earnings, spending and remaining balance.
consultantTransactionsDescription: Review your income and expenses month by month.
vatSettlementsDescription: Record VAT payments without changing income, expenses or profit, and retain a reversible payment history.
recordVatPaymentDescription: Record a payment that reduces the outstanding VAT liability. This does not create an expense.
noVatSettlements: No VAT payments have been recorded yet.
reverseVatPaymentDescription: The payment will remain in history and its amount will be restored to VAT payable.
financeError_noVatPayable: There is no positive VAT liability to pay.
financeError_vatSettlementExceedsPayable: The payment cannot exceed the current VAT payable amount.
financeError_vatSettlementNotFound: The VAT payment could not be found.
financeError_vatSettlementAlreadyReverse: This VAT payment has already been reversed.
vatPayableHistoryDescription: Output VAT on income adds, input VAT on expenses subtracts and VAT payments reduce what is owed, in date order.
outstandingInvoicesDescription: Invoiced amounts that are not paid yet, excluding VAT.
companyOutstandingInvoiceShareDescriptio: Invoiced amounts that are not paid yet, with the part the company keeps after the consultant's share.
consultantBalanceHistoryDescription: Consultant share of paid invoices and credited income, minus consultant-funded expenses, in date order.
earnedShareHistoryDescription: Credits to your balance, such as your share of paid invoices, in date order.
spentFromBalanceHistoryDescription: Amounts deducted from your balance, such as consultant-funded expenses, in date order.
retainedResultHistoryDescription: Company share of paid invoices and manual income, minus company-funded expenses for this consultant, in date order.
fixedRetainedResultHistoryDescription: Paid invoice income minus expenses attributed to this consultant, in date order.
netIncomeHistoryDescription: Net income entries included in this selection, in date order.
companyRetainedResultHistoryDescription: Company net income minus company expenses, in date order.
dateFormatError: Enter the date as yyyy-mm-dd, for example 2026-10-03.
typeTip: Income is money the company receives. Expense is money that is paid out.
categoryTip: The bookkeeping category. The list depends on the type you choose.
consultantTip: The consultant this entry belongs to, or Company only when it is the company's own.
dateTip: The invoice or purchase date. It decides which month and VAT period the entry belongs to.
amountEntryModeTip: Choose which amounts you type in. With net and VAT, both are saved exactly as on the receipt.
totalAmountSekTip: The amount to pay, including VAT and any rounding.
vatAmountSekTip: The VAT amount exactly as printed on the receipt or invoice.
roundingSekTip: Rounding to whole kronor printed on the receipt, plus or minus, such as -0.25. It only changes the total.
fundingTip: Who paid. For consultants with an invoice share, an expense paid by the consultant is deducted from their balance. For fixed salary + invoice share, book the fixed salary as paid by the company and share payouts as paid by the consultant.
applyConsultantShareTip: Credits the consultant with their agreed share of the net amount. Only for compensation with an invoice share.
consultantDescriptionTip: Shown to the consultant in their finance view.
internalNoteTip: Only visible to admins and accountants, never to the consultant.
invoiceNumberTip: The invoice number exactly as printed on the invoice. It must be unique.
periodFromTip: Optional. The first day of the period the invoice is for, for example the first day of the month the work was done.
periodToTip: Optional. The last day of the period the invoice is for. Fill in both dates or neither.
customerTip: The customer the invoice is addressed to.
invoiceConsultantTip: The consultant who did the work, or Company only when no consultant is involved. Decides how the payment is split.
issueDateTip: The invoice date. It decides the consultant's compensation agreement and the VAT period.
dueDateTip: The last day for the customer to pay. It cannot be before the invoice date.
shareOverrideTip: Optional. Replaces the consultant's agreed share for this invoice only. Only for compensation with an invoice share.
transactionShareOverrideTip: Optional. Replaces the consultant's agreed share for this income only. Use 100 to credit the full net amount, for example when returning money the consultant already paid.
vatPaymentDateTip: The day the VAT was paid to the tax account. AI uses the due date when the file shows no payment.
vatPaymentAmountTip: The VAT paid to Skatteverket (Moms att betala). It cannot be more than the VAT currently payable.
vatPeriodFromTip: The first day of the VAT reporting period, for example 2026-04-01 for April - June.
vatPeriodToTip: The last day of the VAT reporting period, for example 2026-06-30 for April - June.
paymentReferenceTip: The OCR or reference number used for the payment.
vatRoundingTip: Optional. Skatteverket declares VAT in whole kronor, so the VAT in the books can differ by some öre. Enter that difference, plus or minus, such as 0.37, to settle it without paying it.
vatNoteTip: Only visible to admins and accountants.
financeCorrectionReason: Correction entered by an administrator or accountant.

chartZoomHint: Drag across the chart to zoom into a range.
consultantInvoicesDescription: View the full invoice amounts connected to your work. Your finance overview records only your configured share as income.

transactionDeleted: The financial entry was permanently deleted.

financeError_transactionNotDeletable: A reversed entry or its original entry cannot be permanently deleted.
financeError_transactionNotEditable: Invoice-generated, reversed, and reversal entries cannot be edited.

transactionMonthMismatchWarning: You are in {viewMonth} view and adding an {transactionType} for {transactionMonth}. Are you sure you want to continue?
vatMismatchWarning: Net amount {net} at {rate}% VAT gives {expected} in VAT, but the VAT amount entered is {vat}. Do you want to continue with the amounts as entered, or go back and check them?
invoiceTransactionDeleteProtected: This entry was generated by a paid invoice and cannot be deleted independently.

mfaChallengeBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown for Debageri Portal.
mfaRequiredBody: The portal contains sensitive financial information, so every account must now be protected with two-factor authentication. Install an authenticator app on your phone, scan the QR code below and enter the code from the app. You only need to do this once.
mfaScanQr: Open the app, choose to add an account, and scan this QR code.
mfaQrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor authentication
mfaSetupKey: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
mfaEnrollCodeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app
mfaInvalidCode: The code is incorrect or has expired. Enter the current code from the app.
mfaSetupFailed: Two-factor setup could not be completed. Please try again or contact your administrator.
mfaSessionExpired: The sign-in took too long. Please sign in again.
mfaEnrolledSignInAgain: Two-factor authentication is now active. Sign in again and enter a code from the app.
mfaResetDescription: Their authenticator app is removed and all their sessions are signed out. They must set up two-factor authentication again the next time they sign in. Use this when someone has lost or replaced their phone.
mfaResetDone: Two-factor login was reset for {name}. They will set it up again at their next sign-in.
mfaResetFailed: Two-factor login could not be reset. Please try again.
myReceiptsDescription: Upload receipts for approval and follow their status.
reviewReceiptsDescription: Approve or reject receipts from consultants and managers, and book approved ones as expenses.
uploadReceiptDescription: Add the receipt file, its date, a name and the amounts. It is sent for approval.
receiptSubmitted: Your receipt was submitted and is waiting for approval.
receiptFileHelp: One PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file of up to 5 MB.
receiptError_invalidAmount: Enter the total excluding VAT and the VAT amount.
receiptError_vatTooHigh: VAT cannot be higher than the total excluding VAT.
expenseFromReceiptAmounts: Receipt amounts: {net} excluding VAT + {vat} VAT = {total}. Check the VAT % below, since it is worked out from these amounts.
noReceiptsDescription: No receipts match the selected filters.
noOwnReceiptsDescription: Receipts you upload will appear here with their status.
addReceiptAsExpenseQuestion: The receipt "{name}" from {person} is approved. Do you want to add it as an expense now?
expenseFromReceiptFundingHelp: The date, consultant, amount, VAT, descriptions and receipt file are filled in. Choose the category, and whether the expense is company or consultant funded.
expenseFromReceiptCompanyOnly: {person} is not a consultant, so this expense is booked as company funded. The date, amount, VAT, descriptions and receipt file are filled in.
expenseReceiptFileMissing: The receipt file could not be attached automatically. Download it from the receipt and attach it here.
receiptError_invalidInput: Check the name, date, amounts and description and try again.
receiptError_receiptFileTooLarge: The receipt file must be 5 MB or smaller.
receiptError_receiptFileType: Use a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
receiptError_receiptSaveFailed: The receipt could not be submitted. Please try again.
receiptError_receiptReviewFailed: The status could not be changed. Please try again.
receiptError_receiptExpenseLinked: This receipt is already added as an expense, so its status can no longer change.
financeError_receiptNotExpensable: This receipt is not approved or has already been added as an expense.
financeError_incomingEmailAlreadyConvert: This email has already been turned into a record or dismissed.
financeError_notFound: The record could not be found.
notificationEmailsHelp: Sent with the SMTP connection, in each person's portal language.
notificationEmailsNoSmtp: No notification emails are sent until the SMTP connection is saved.
notificationTopicHelp_receipts: Admins and accountants hear about new receipts; the submitter hears when a receipt is approved or rejected.
notificationTopicHelp_payslips: The person is told when their pay slip is uploaded or replaced, if they have pay slip access.
notificationTopicHelp_timesheets: The person is told when their time report is approved or rejected, including the reason.

notificationTitle_timesheetApproved: Your time report for {week} was approved
notificationTitle_timesheetRejected: Your time report for {week} was rejected
emailTemplate_receiptSubmitted: Receipt waiting for approval (to admins and accountants)
emailTemplateLanguageHelp: Each person gets the email in their portal language, so edit both versions.
emailTemplateCustomized: This is your own version of the email.
emailTemplateUsingDefault: This is the built-in text. Save to use your own version.
emailTemplateResetDone: The built-in text is used again.
emailPreferencesDescription: Choose which emails you get. You still see everything under the bell in the portal.
emailPreferencesNoneAvailable: There are no optional emails for your account.
emailPreferenceHelp_receipts: New receipts to review, and decisions on your own receipts.
emailPreferenceHelp_payslips: When a new pay slip is available.
emailPreferenceHelp_timesheets: When your time report is approved or rejected.
emailPreferencesSaveFailed: Your email settings could not be saved. Please try again.
employeeSaveFailed: The employee could not be saved. Please try again.
employeeTabIntro_general: Name, contact details, role and sign-in.
employeeTabIntro_employment: Employment dates and when time reporting starts.
employeeTabIntro_access: The access profile decides which parts of the portal this person can use.
employeeTabIntro_notifications: Which notification emails this person gets. Notifications in the portal are always shown.
employeeNoTimeReporting: This person does not report time, so no reporting start date is needed.
employeeAccessByRole: Administrators have full access, so there is nothing to set here.
aiIntegrationDescription: Turn AI assistance on or off, choose the provider and model, and decide which sections may use it.
aiEnableIntegrationHelp: When off, no section calls the AI provider, whatever is selected below.
aiApiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Each provider keeps its own key.
aiLeaveBlankApiKey: Leave blank to keep the existing key
aiApiKeyRequired: Enter an API key for the selected provider before enabling AI.
aiEnabledSectionsHelp: Choose where people can use AI. Files are sent to the selected provider only when someone asks for it.
aiSectionsDisabled: Turn on the AI integration under Provider to choose sections.
aiFeatureHelp_financeAttachments: Adds “Process attachment with AI” next to each file, filling in date, amounts, VAT and category from the document.
aiFeatureHelp_financeInvoices: Adds “Process attachment with AI” next to each file on a new invoice, filling in invoice number, customer, consultant, dates, amount and VAT from the document.
aiFeatureHelp_financeVatSettlements: Adds “Process attachment with AI” next to each file on a VAT payment, filling in the period, amount, due date, OCR reference and note from Skatteverket's receipt.
aiFeatureHelp_financeIncomingEmails: Reads emails forwarded to the finance mailbox from trusted senders, recognizes whether each is an income, an expense or an invoice and prepares it for approval under Finance › Incoming financial emails.
aiSettingsSaveFailed: AI settings could not be saved.
aiFilledFromFile: Filled in from {name}. Review the values before posting.
aiNothingFound: No transaction values could be read from {name}.
aiForeignCurrency: The document is in {currency} and no exchange rate was found, so the amount was left empty. Enter the SEK amount yourself.
aiVatDiffers: The document states VAT {vat}, which differs slightly from the calculated VAT. Adjust if needed.
aiError_aiDisabled: AI is not enabled for this section.
aiError_aiNotConfigured: AI is not fully configured. Ask an administrator to add an API key.
aiError_aiUnsupportedFile: This file type cannot be read with AI.
aiError_aiProviderRejected: The AI provider rejected the request. Check the API key and model in AI integration settings.
aiError_aiProviderFailed: The AI provider could not be reached. Try again shortly.
aiError_aiNoResult: The AI could not read this file.
aiError_attachmentTooLarge: The file is too large to process.
selectConsultantError: Please select a consultant, or Company only.
aiChooseRemaining: Fields still showing “Select” could not be read from the file. Choose them yourself.
aiNotVatDocument: {name} does not look like a VAT return receipt or VAT payment. The values that could be read were filled in; check them carefully.
aiConversionCheck: The amounts were in {currency} and have been converted to SEK. Double-check them against the document before posting.
incomingFinancialEmailsDescription: Receipts and invoices forwarded to the finance mailbox. Check what AI read from each email and turn it into an income, an expense or an invoice with a few clicks.
incomingEmailSettingsDescription: Forward receipts and invoices to a dedicated mailbox. The portal reads it every hour from 08:00 to 23:00, or straight away with Read now under Finance. Only emails from the trusted senders below are read; their text and attachments are kept for further processing, and nothing is booked until someone approves it.
incomingEmailAiOff: Incoming emails are only read when AI integration is on and “Finance: Process incoming financial emails” is ticked under its sections.
incomingEmailMailboxOff: The finance mailbox is not set up or is switched off.
imapHostTip: The server the portal reads mail from, such as imap.gmail.com or outlook.office365.com. Incoming mail is read over IMAP, not SMTP.
imapPasswordTip: Use an app password when the mail provider offers one. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
imapFolderTip: The folder to read, usually INBOX.
imapSecureTip: Connect with TLS from the start, which port 993 expects. Untick only for servers that upgrade the connection with STARTTLS.
incomingEmailEnabledTip: When ticked, the mailbox is read every hour from 08:00 to 23:00 and with Read now. Read messages are marked as read in the mailbox.
incomingEmailTestSucceeded: The portal could sign in and open the folder.
incomingEmailTestFailed: The mailbox could not be reached.
incomingEmailError_mailboxAuthFailed: The mail server did not accept the username or password.
incomingEmailError_mailboxFolderMissing: The folder does not exist in this mailbox.
incomingEmailError_mailboxConnectionFail: The mail server could not be reached. Check the server, port and TLS setting.
